brief.headline: SK Hynix outperforms Samsung as HBM3e 12-Hi qualification flow gathers pace; KRW weakness adds tailwind to memory export earnings.
brief.summary: SK Hynix (+2.1%) extended its YTD outperformance vs Samsung (+0.4%) into the Korean close as TrendForce flagged tightening HBM3e 12-Hi supply ahead of GB300 ramp. USD/KRW pushed to 1,386, the highest in three weeks, providing operating leverage for both names. Micron's overnight ADR move (+1.8%) and Kioxia's relative weakness suggest the bid is concentrated in HBM-exposed names rather than broad commodity DRAM. No material DART filings since last cycle.
brief.pair_trade_view: Long 000660 / Short 005930 spread held its YTD widening; the HBM revenue mix gap (SK Hynix 60%+ HBM share vs Samsung 30%) is the persistent driver. Watch for any Samsung GB300 qual headline as the potential mean-reversion catalyst.

memory_cycle.notes: HBM tightness extends through 2H26 on TrendForce updated capacity model; commodity DRAM contract pricing flattening but spot still firm. NAND lagging - WDC down on the session reflects this. Watch SamsungElectronics Q2 capex guide for the first signal that supply discipline is wavering.

brief.hbm_pulse: GB300 server rack ramp at hyperscalers (per Nvidia field commentary) is pulling forward HBM3e 12-Hi demand into 2H26. SK Hynix retains qualification lead; Samsung's HBM3e qual at Nvidia remains the most-watched binary catalyst into Q2 prints. CoWoS supply is the gating factor, not HBM die supply, per TSMC's latest investor comments - relevant for understanding the bottleneck stack.

key_filings.summary_en: Quarterly business report supplement filed (auditor opinion attached). No material change vs Q1 release.
Director board meeting decision: dividend declaration confirmed at KRW 361/share, in line with prior guidance.
